title: [MAIN] Avoid empty GST component lookup on customer reapplication (Bug 659069)
summary: Fixed a bug where reapplying customer payments after unapplication would fail with an empty GST component lookup error by skipping GST account resolution when no GST entries are involved.
key_points: Reapplying customer payments against invoices after unapplication now works without errors
GST application routine exits early when the GST posting buffer is empty
Prevents blank GST component code from triggering a failed lookup
Avoids unnecessary account resolution and posting when no GST entries exist
quote: Exit the GST application update routine when the temporary GST posting buffer is empty, avoiding unnecessary account resolution and posting.
